svg.title: Green Red-Orange
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study after an inspected primary museum photograph. Geometry approximate; vivid screen colour not calibrated. Two joined panels form a rectangular overall canvas with slanted green/red-orange seam. Study groups red-orange as orange.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://addison.andover.edu/wp-content/uploads/Image-Highlights_Playing-to-Our-Strengths.pdf; source object 1991.39; inspected 2026-10-27; hand-authored approximation.
